title: Weather Detect
description: Weather Detect is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod that shows notifications when the weather changes in your world.
body:
# 🌦️ Weather Detect

**Weather Detect** is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod that shows Minecraft-style toast notifications when the weather changes in your world.

Open the animated in-game menu with a configurable keybind and choose which weather events you want to be notified about.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🌧️ Rain start notifications
- ⛈️ Thunderstorm start notifications
- ☀️ Clear weather notifications
- ⌨️ Configurable keybind
- 🖥️ Client-side only
- 🌍 Multi-language support

---

## 🎮 How To Use

Press **`O`** by default to open the Weather Detect menu.

From there, you can enable or disable notifications for each weather state:

- 🌧️ Rain
- ⛈️ Thunderstorm
- ☀️ Clear weather

For example, if rain notifications are enabled, a Minecraft-style toast will appear in the top-right corner when rain starts.

---

## 🧩 Compatibility

Weather Detect is built for **Fabric** and requires **Fabric API**.

Minecraft 1.21.x support is split into two jar files:

| Minecraft Version | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1.21 - 1.21.8 | `weather-detect-mc1.21-1.21.8-1.0.0.jar` |
| 1.21.9 - 1.21.11 | `weather-detect-mc1.21.9-1.21.11-1.0.0.jar` |

---

## 🌐 Multiplayer Support

Weather Detect is fully **client-side**.

That means:

- ✅ No server installation required
- ✅ Works in singleplayer
- ✅ Works on most multiplayer servers

---

## 📦 Requirements

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

---
